title: 第3章 小还丹第4章 谋划
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
他慌忙的摇摇头：“我们交易的证据我放在我的住处了，你跟我一起去取吧，我绝对不会逃跑的。”
“此话当真？”
江辰摸了摸下巴，仿佛真的在思考他的这个建议。
“是真的，我绝对不会骗你的，如果到时候我拿不出来的话，你就直接杀了我！”
李成器跪在地上慌张的继续说道：“我家里还有一千两银子和三颗魔血丹，这些东西我都可以给你，只求你放我一条生路吧。”
“我也是太长时间没能冲开任督二脉，一时鬼迷心窍才和魔教做生意的。”
李成器的表情诚恳，语气卑微，仿佛真的是个行差踏错的好人一样。
“那你带路吧。”
江辰的声音平静，仿佛真的被李成器的言辞所打动，他轻轻挥了挥手，示意李成器起身。
然而，李成器却并未立刻起身，他低下头，额前的碎发遮住了他的眼睛，让人看不清他此刻的表情。
但就在那低垂的眼睑之下，一抹阴狠之色悄然闪过。
他怎么可能就这样束手就擒？
李成器心中暗自盘算，如果被锦衣卫抓回去的话，等待他的将是无尽的审讯和残酷的刑罚，最终仍然是死路一条。
“等会回到京城，我一定要想办法找我叔叔，然后直接诬告他杀害上司，说他私通魔教，图谋不轨。
哼，不管他是束手就擒，还是奋力反抗，我都可以借由锦衣卫之手，把他慢慢玩死，让他求生不得，求死不能！”
李成器一边在心中暗暗盘算，一边露出了得意的笑容，仿佛已经看到了江辰被折磨得痛不欲生的画面。
然而，就在他沉浸在自己的幻想之中，得意忘形之际，突然感觉后脑传来一阵剧痛，仿佛被什么重物狠狠地击中了一般。
他手中的筷子如同闪电一般，精准无误地插入了李成器的后脑，然后轻轻一旋，便带着一股鲜血飞了出去，稳稳地插在了这家酒楼的墙壁之上。
李成器的身体顿时僵住，他瞪大了眼睛，满脸不可置信地看着江辰，仿佛无法理解眼前发生的一切。
他的嘴角微微张开，却已经发不出任何声音。

江辰冷冷地看着李成器，眼神中充满了不屑。
他轻轻拍了拍手，仿佛嫌杀李成器脏了自己的手一样。
【罪恶值+132】
他从一开始就没有打算放过李成器。
开什么玩笑，这132点罪恶值他怎么可能舍得让给别人。
刚才问他也不过是想直接拿到证据，也省的自己再慢慢搜身了。
“系统打开个人面板。”
随着他的话音落下，半空之中突然出现了一个淡蓝色的光幕。
【姓名：江辰】
【境界：先天境巅峰】
【罪恶值：132】
【武功：龙象般若功十三重（玄品下阶，已圆满，再升级需耗费三十六万罪恶值）】
【宝物：无】
看着升级龙象般若功需要三十六万罪恶值，江辰果断将目光投向了抽奖界面。
“系统，我现在可以抽奖吗？”
“可以！
系统转盘分为白，绿，蓝，紫，金，红，六个等级，100点罪恶值可开启一次白色抽奖转盘。”
“那就先抽一次白色转盘吧。”
江辰大手一挥，直接说道。
话音刚落，一个白色的转盘出现在了他的面前。

在这个转盘上有着丹药，功法，钱财，天材地宝以及空白五片区域，所抽取到的几率各为五分之一。
content_en:
He shook his head hurriedly: "I have placed the evidence of our transaction at my residence. You can go get it with me. I will never run away."
"Is this true?"
Jiang Chen touched his chin, as if he was really thinking about his suggestion.
"It's true. I will never lie to you. If I can't show it by then, just kill me!"
Li Chengqi knelt on the ground and continued in panic: "I still have one thousand taels of silver and three magic blood pills at home. I can give you these things. I just ask you to let me live."
"It's been too long since I was able to break through the Ren and Du channels, so I did business with the Demon Sect out of obsession."
Li Chengqi's expression was sincere and his tone was humble, as if he was really a good person who made a mistake.
"Then you lead the way."
Jiang Chen's voice was calm, as if he was really moved by Li Chengqi's words. He waved his hand gently, signaling Li Chengqi to stand up.
However, Li Chengqi did not stand up immediately. He lowered his head, and the broken hair on his forehead covered his eyes, making it difficult to see his expression clearly.
But just under those lowered eyelids, a sinister look quietly flashed across his face.
How could he just surrender like this?
Li Chengqi secretly calculated that if he was captured by Jin Yiwei, what awaited him would be endless interrogations and cruel punishments, and he would still be dead in the end.
"When I return to the capital later, I must find a way to find my uncle, and then directly accuse him of killing my boss, saying that he is having an affair with the devil's sect and has evil intentions.
Humph, no matter whether he is captured without any help or struggling to resist, I can use the hands of the Jin Yiwei to slowly kill him, making him unable to survive or die! "
While Li Chengqi was secretly calculating in his heart, he showed a proud smile, as if he had seen the scene of Jiang Chen being tortured to the point of death.
However, just when he was immersed in his fantasy and was getting carried away, he suddenly felt a sharp pain in the back of his head, as if he had been hit hard by something heavy.
The chopsticks in his hand were like lightning, inserted into the back of Li Chengqi's head with precision, and then with a slight twist, they flew out with a stream of blood, and were firmly inserted into the wall of the restaurant.
Li Chengqi's body suddenly froze. His eyes widened and he looked at Jiang Chen with disbelief, as if he couldn't understand what was happening in front of him.
The corners of his mouth opened slightly, but no sound came out.
Jiang Chen looked at Li Chengqi coldly, his eyes full of disdain.
He clapped his hands gently, as if he thought killing Li Chengqi had dirty his hands.
[Sin value +132]
He had no intention of letting Li Chengqi go from the beginning.
Are you kidding? How could he be willing to give up these 132 sin points to others.
When I asked him just now, I just wanted to get the evidence directly and save myself from having to search him slowly.
"The system opens the personal panel."
As his words fell, a light blue light curtain suddenly appeared in mid-air.
[Name: Jiang Chen]
[Realm: Peak of Xiantian Realm]
[Sin value: 132]
[Martial Arts: The Thirteenth Level of Dragon-Elephant Prajna Kung Fu (lower level of Xuanpin, perfected, further upgrades will cost 360,000 sin points)]
[Treasure: None]
Seeing that upgrading the Dragon Elephant Prajna Skill requires 360,000 sin points, Jiang Chen decisively turned his attention to the lottery interface.
"System, can I draw a lottery now?"
"Okay!
The system wheel is divided into six levels: white, green, blue, purple, gold, and red. 100 sin points can open a white lottery wheel. "
"Then let's smoke the white wheel first."
Jiang Chen waved his hand and said directly.
As soon as he finished speaking, a white turntable appeared in front of him.
On this turntable, there are five areas including elixirs, skills, money, heavenly materials and earthly treasures, as well as blank areas. The probability of drawing each one is one-fifth.
